column1: prompt

Write a Go function named Fibonacci that takes an int n and returns the nth Fibonacci number using an iterative approach. The function signature should be: func Fibonacci(n int) int. Include a short example in a main function that prints Fibonacci(10).

Write a Go HTTP handler function HandleCreateUser that accepts POST requests to /users with a JSON body containing 'name' (string) and 'email' (string). Validate that both fields are non-empty. Return 201 Created with the created user JSON on success, or 400 Bad Request with an error message if validation fails. Use standard library only.

Write a Go function ReadConfig that reads a JSON configuration file from a given path and unmarshals it into a Config struct. Wrap all errors using fmt.Errorf with %w so callers can use errors.Is. The Config struct has fields: Host string, Port int, Debug bool.
golang fibonacci function iterative implementation in Go, function takes int n returns int, write the function and show fibonacci(10) output

Implement a Go HTTP endpoint that handles POST requests at path /users, reads a JSON body with name and email string fields, validates both are present and non-empty, responds with HTTP 201 and the user object as JSON or HTTP 400 with an error. Use only the standard library.

Write a Go function that opens a JSON config file at a given file path, decodes it into a struct with Host string Port int Debug bool fields, and wraps any file or decode errors using fmt.Errorf with percent-w for error chain support.

Implement a Validate method on a Go User struct. The method should return an error if Name is empty, if Email does not contain an at-sign, or if Age is outside the range 0 to 150. Return a descriptive message for each case.

Write a Go function named Factorial that takes an int n and returns n! using an iterative loop. The function signature should be: func Factorial(n int) int. Include a short main function that prints Factorial(10).

Write a Go HTTP handler function HandleCreateProduct that accepts POST requests to /products with a JSON body containing 'title' (string) and 'price' (float64). Validate that title is non-empty and price is greater than 0. Return 201 Created with the product JSON on success, or 400 Bad Request on validation failure. Use standard library only.

Write a Go function ParseJSON that reads a JSON file from disk at a given path and unmarshals it into a map[string]interface{}. Wrap all errors using fmt.Errorf with the %w verb for proper error chain support. Return the map and any error.

Write a Go function named Tribonacci that takes an int n and returns the nth Tribonacci number using an iterative approach. Function signature: func Tribonacci(n int) int. Include a main function printing Tribonacci(10).

Write a Go HTTP handler function HandleCreateOrder that accepts POST requests to /orders with a JSON body containing 'customer_id' (int) and 'amount' (float64). Validate customer_id is nonzero and amount is greater than 0. Return 201 Created with the order JSON on success, 400 Bad Request on failure.

Write a Go function that reads environment variables for DB_HOST, DB_PORT as int, DB_NAME all required and DB_SSL optional bool defaulting false. Returns DBConfig struct. Wraps missing variable errors with fmt.Errorf.
Write a Go function BinarySearch that performs binary search on a sorted []int slice and returns the index of the target or -1. Add a main demonstrating search for value 42.
Write a Go HTTP handler HandleListUsers for GET /users returning a JSON array. Support limit default 10 max 100 and offset default 0 query params. User struct has ID int Name string Email string.
Write a Go function LinearSearch that performs linear search on a []int slice and returns the index of the target value or -1 if not found. Include a main demonstrating a search for value 42.
Write a Go HTTP handler HandleGetProduct that accepts GET /products/:id with int id path param. Look up in in-memory map[int]Product. Return 200 with product JSON or 404 if not found.

Write a Go function ConfigFromFlags that reads -host string required, -port int default 8080, -debug bool default false from os.Args using the flag package. Return a Config struct and an error if -host is missing.

Add Validate to a Go Order struct. Check CustomerID is nonzero, Items slice is nonempty, each item has Quantity above zero and UnitPrice non-negative, and TotalAmount equals the computed sum. Return all errors.
Write a Go function WatchFile that reads a file at given path retrying up to 3 times on error with 1 second sleep between retries. Wrap the final error with fmt.Errorf and %w if all retries fail.

Write a Go Validate method for the following Address struct: Street not empty, City not empty, ZipCode exactly 5 digits, CountryCode exactly 2 uppercase letters. Return descriptive errors:

type Address struct {
    Street      string
    City        string
    ZipCode     string
    CountryCode string
}
Write a Go function named SumDigits that takes an int n and returns the sum of all its digits using an iterative approach. Include a main function that prints SumDigits(12345).
Write a Go HTTP handler HandleCreateComment for POST /comments with JSON body containing post_id int and body string. Validate post_id nonzero and body non-empty under 1000 chars. Return 201 or 400.
Write a Go function ReadYAML that reads a file at given path returning its bytes as string. Wrap all IO errors using fmt.Errorf with %w. Signature: func ReadYAML(path string) (string, error)
Write a Go function isPrime that takes an int n and returns bool using trial division. Write iterative version without external packages. Include main printing isPrime(97) and isPrime(100).
Write a Go HTTP handler HandleHealthCheck for GET /health that returns JSON with status ok, current unix timestamp, and version string from a package-level variable. Use standard library only.
Write a Go function MustGetEnv that takes a key string and returns the environment variable value. If the variable is not set or empty, it panics with a descriptive message including the key name.

Write a Go Validate method for the following Subscription struct: PlanID must be one of 'free', 'pro', 'enterprise', StartDate must be before EndDate, MaxSeats must be between 1 and 10000:

type Subscription struct {
    PlanID    string
    StartDate time.Time
    EndDate   time.Time
    MaxSeats  int
}
Write a Go function named GCD that computes the greatest common divisor of two integers using Euclidean algorithm iteratively. Signature: func GCD(a, b int) int. Include main printing GCD(48, 18).

Write a Go HTTP handler HandleUpdateUser for PUT /users/{id} that reads an int id from the URL path, reads a JSON body with optional name and email fields, validates email format if provided, updates the in-memory user store, returns 200 with updated user or 404 if not found.

Write a Go function RetryWithBackoff that takes a function fn func() error, maxRetries int, and initialDelay time.Duration. Retries fn up to maxRetries times with exponential backoff (delay doubles each attempt). Returns the last error if all retries fail. Wrap each error with attempt number using fmt.Errorf.
